description: Microsoft Windows Security Baseline for Windows 11 version 23H2 / SCT

controls.title: Defender Real-Time & Cloud Protection Baseline
controls.description: Microsoft Defender Antivirus must have Real-Time Protection and Cloud Telemetry enabled.

controls.title: Windows Firewall Profile Baselines
controls.description: Domain, Private, and Public firewall profiles must be active with default block inbound.

controls.title: LSASS Protected Process Light (PPL)
controls.description: LSA must execute as Protected Process Light to defend against credential dumping.

controls.title: UAC Admin Approval Mode & Secure Desktop
controls.description: Enable UAC Admin Approval Mode and Secure Desktop prompts.

controls.title: SMB Security & Protocol Hardening
controls.description: Disable SMBv1 and enforce SMB packet signing.

controls.title: Advanced Audit Policy Baseline
controls.description: Enforce process creation command line auditing and logon event auditing.

controls.title: PowerShell Script Block Logging Baseline
controls.description: Enable PowerShell script block logging to record script execution in Event 4104.
